_comment: Curated seed list for atlas-wiki-materialize. Each seed has a canonical name, a canonical_id (the wiki page filename), regex patterns matched case-insensitively against meeting titles and summaries, and a one-line description used on the entity page. client_aliases maps a CRM company shortname (the primary label of an email domain) to the client folder it belongs to, so the org branch does not create a duplicate org page for a known client.
